comparison.objective: Set a telescoping gauge to a bore diameter and return it to a stand; candidate screens finishing media.
comparison.physical_skill: Gauge work requires compliant bore contact, centreline sweeping, locking, and careful withdrawal with 0.10 mm accuracy, not loose-body agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Correct span after removal, gauge released and still on its stand across three lots; candidate requires recovered mass, washer retention, supported screen, clearance, and dwell.
comparison.reason: Precision dimensional transfer is unrelated to selective aperture separation; the gauge record gives no numeric stillness duration, but that missing detail does not suggest overlap.
